before.overview: Continuing the forum creation workflow for 'Cyberpunk', the agent proceeds to fill the 'Title' field. This step is essential to meet the form's requirement for a title before moving on to the description and sidebar configuration.
before.state_transition: The action updates the 'Title' textbox from an empty state to contain the value 'Cyberpunk'. The 'Name' field retains its previous value, and the 'Title' textbox becomes focused in the post-state, signaling that the second required field is now complete and the form is ready for the next input.

before.overview: The agent is creating a new forum named 'Cyberpunk' on the Postmill platform. Having already set the name and title, this step focuses on populating the 'Description' field with the required text 'Welcome to the future' to satisfy the task goal before moving to the sidebar configuration.
before.state_transition: In the pre-state, the 'Description' textbox (ID 126) is visible but empty, while the Name and Title fields are already filled with 'Cyberpunk'. After the agent fills the textbox with 'Welcome to the future', the post-state shows this value populated within the description field, and the field gains a 'focused' state, indicating readiness for the next input step without any page navigation or modal changes.

after.overview: Continuing the forum creation workflow for 'Cyberpunk', the agent proceeds to fill the 'Title' field. This step is essential to meet the form's requirement for a title before moving on to the description and sidebar configuration.
after.state_transition: The action updates the 'Title' textbox from an empty state to contain the value 'Cyberpunk'.
